title: Implement bounded retry semantics
prompt: Fix `app/retry.py` so `retry(operation, attempts=3)` retries a callable after exceptions. It returns the first successful result, raises the last exception after exactly `attempts` failures, and raises `ValueError` when attempts is less than one. Do not sleep or add dependencies. Edit production code only; do not modify tests. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
